parsed.name: AMI超导磁体系统
parsed.description: 用于低温与强磁场实验的超导磁体系统，可由电源编程器控制磁场设定与扫描，并支持稳定磁场输出及相关状态监测。
parsed.description_en: A superconducting magnet system for cryogenic and high-field laboratory experiments, with programmable field control and sweep capability plus stable-field operation and status monitoring.
